contentItem.title: 倾角相等的平面
contentItem.englishTitle: A plane is said to be similarly inclined to a plane as another is to another when the said angles of the inclinations are equal to one another.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A plane is said to be similarly inclined to a plane as another is to another when the said angles of the inclinations are equal to one another.
据说,平面型与平面型类似,而当所述倾角的角对等时,则与另一型相同。（相关点与线段：A）
